title: Static Open-Mouth Continuous-Fin Moray
description: One newly authored whole stylised moray-like fish exterior: a long laterally compressed curved trunk narrows continuously into a fin-fringed tail. Real dorsal and anal median margins share the whole body surface along its length, not separate decoration plates. A broad blunt head has a real forward-opening thick-lipped blind mouth cavity and small lateral eyes; no tongue, limb, external pectoral fins or snake-scale claim. Every full path, tall section, fin margin and mouth wall is newly drawn, not old S-snake arrays recoloured or an ordinary fish stretched. One static animal prop, zero scenes. Lowermost finite fin underside is a display datum only, not living support or species anatomy. No teeth/gills/internal organs, bite, dangerousness, swimming, animation, rig or interaction claim.
